---
title: "Mixed R and Python environment smoke test"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RENV_PROJECT"))
stopifnot(startsWith(normalizePath(.libPaths()[1L]), file.path(root, "renv", "library")))
```

```{python}
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

root = Path(os.environ["RENV_PROJECT"]).resolve()
assert Path(sys.executable).resolve() == (root / ".venv/bin/python").resolve()
assert np.__version__
```
